_rule: Four-domain schematic (author, 2026-10-14): one standard name per slot, each domain's native word kept beside it. Status is one of derived, measured, calculated, prediction, conjecture, candidate, open. 'candidate' = proposed and not tested; 'open' = nothing yet. FOUR_DOMAINS.md and its gap map are generated from this file by CANON/four_domains.py; never edit them by hand.

slots.name: Encoding surface
slots.definition: Where the irreversible record is written.

cosmos.native: cosmic horizon; for a black hole, its own horizon
cosmos.formula: area A of the apparent horizon, r_A = 1/H

qubits.formula: two-level record held across a gap hf
qubits.source: Ch. Each platform on its own gauge: qubits

chips.source: Ch. Landauer at the transistor gate

slots.name: Surface temperature T_s
slots.definition: The temperature the record actually sees.

qubits.formula: T_q (e.g. 35 mK, not the 15 mK fridge)

slots.name: Bit price e_bit
slots.definition: IAM's Law: the minimum cost of one classical bit.

cosmos.native: cost of a bit at the horizon

chips.formula: k_B T_j ln2 = 3.33e-21 J at 75 C

slots.name: Drive energy E_drive
slots.definition: The energy spent per event to write or hold the record.

cosmos.formula: Mc^2 (black hole: Mc^2 = 2 T_H S, Smarr)

slots.name: Mahaffey number M
slots.definition: Drive over the thermal quantum, M = E_drive / k_B T_s (App. E #47, #485).

cosmos.formula: candidate: M = S/k_B for the cosmic horizon (bits cost all its rest energy), about 2.3e122; black hole M = 2S/k_B

qubits.formula: M = hf / k_B T_q = 6.86 (5 GHz, 35 mK)

slots.name: Floor (left mark)
slots.definition: The lowest error a record can hold against thermal kicks at full drive.

cosmos.formula: S = A / 4 l_P^2: one nat per 4 l_P^2

chips.native: Landauer and reliability floors; Boltzmann wall
chips.formula: k_B T_j ln2; E_min = k_B T ln(1/p); swing (k_B T/q) ln10 = 60 mV/decade

slots.name: Balance law
slots.definition: How the held error is set: restore against loss.

cells.formula: eps = f/(f+g), E_hold = k_B T ln(g/f)

slots.name: Reference (the 1)
slots.definition: The state the gauge is read against.

chips.formula: the chip on one stated definition

cells.formula: eps0 = 0.032, E_hold = 3.41 k_B T; candidate derivation ln D - ln 2 (DEV-ERASE-01, sealed)

slots.name: Ceiling (right mark)
slots.definition: Saturation: the surface can no longer hold a record.

cosmos.formula: local area bound filled; the cosmic horizon never saturates on observable timescales

cells.formula: coin flip, eps = 1/2 at every identity site, A = 4.26

slots.name: Writer (potential half)
slots.definition: What adds the record onto the surface.

cosmos.formula: geometric deposit, stored in spacetime curvature; |V|/2

slots.name: Eraser (kinetic half)
slots.definition: What frees the surface; the Landauer step.

cosmos.formula: informational pressure on the horizon, driving expansion; K = |V|/2

qubits.native: erasure of a discarded TLS flip
qubits.formula: each discarded flip is an erasure paid in heat; minimum Delta_Al ln2 at the gap scale; above 2 Delta it breaks a Cooper pair into quasiparticles (sets x_qp)
qubits.source: Ch. The cost of holding a qubit (p5_02_xqp); IAM_Xqp paper

chips.formula: candidate: reset of an unknown bit (CMOS erases at almost every gate)

slots.name: Virial partition
slots.definition: The two halves are equal: 2K + V = 0 for any 1/r binding (Clausius 1870), so K = |V|/2.

cosmos.formula: 2K + V = 0; beta_m = Omega_m/2 = 0.15765 = Omega_m x f_coll x eta_vir (f_coll 0.62, Tinker 2008)
cosmos.source: App. E #49, #28; six independent N-body groups (Bryan & Norman 1998, Bett 2007, Neto 2007, Ludlow 2010, Power 2012, Klypin 2016): <eta_vir> = 0.815 +/- 0.025; 17 Planck chains

qubits.native: Coulomb binding of the junction's electrons
qubits.formula: 2K + V = 0 for the Coulomb (1/r) binding of electrons and nuclei: 20 atoms H-Xe and 10 molecules at the Hartree-Fock limit, exact (Clementi & Roetti 1974; Bunge 1993). The qubit's own degree of freedom is not 1/r: a transmon is near-harmonic (degree 2, K = V)
qubits.source: Ch. The virial partition (p1_03); Virial Partition Across Wide Domains, Table 1

chips.native: Coulomb binding of the electrons in silicon
chips.formula: 2K + V = 0 for the Coulomb (1/r) binding of electrons and nuclei: 20 atoms H-Xe and 10 molecules at the Hartree-Fock limit, exact (Clementi & Roetti 1974; Bunge 1993). The switch itself is transport over a barrier, not a 1/r bound state

cells.native: Coulomb binding of the molecules (DNA, enzymes)
cells.formula: 2K + V = 0 for the Coulomb (1/r) binding of electrons and nuclei: 20 atoms H-Xe and 10 molecules at the Hartree-Fock limit, exact (Clementi & Roetti 1974; Bunge 1993). Which process carries which half in methylation is the separate writer/eraser question (DEV-ERASE-01)

slots.name: Kinetic-half identity
slots.definition: When a 1/r system binds from rest, the energy it releases equals its kinetic half, and that is the Landauer cost of the binding: K = Q = T dS_min = E_Landauer.

cosmos.native: Smarr: horizon bits cost half the rest energy; record term at the cosmic horizon
cosmos.formula: N k_B T_H ln2 = T_H S = Mc^2/2 (Schwarzschild, exact); Kerr share sqrt(1-chi^2)/2
cosmos.source: App. E #348, #499; Smarr 1973; Bardeen, Carter & Hawking 1973; Thermodynamic Identity paper

qubits.formula: E_erase >= Delta_Al ln2 per discarded flip; N_QP = ln2 per event at the gap scale

chips.formula: k_B T_j ln2 per erased bit

cells.formula: candidate: equal writer and eraser loss lowers the holding by exactly ln2 (one Landauer bit): E_hold = ln D - ln 2

slots.name: Virial ratio R
slots.definition: Total against the kinetic half; 2 at equilibrium.

qubits.formula: candidate: total gate-error loss / reset loss, from an error budget

cells.formula: (writer + eraser loss) / eraser loss: 1.90 (1.61-2.76 over the writer's range), after the fact

slots.name: Clock x
slots.definition: The variable the record accumulates against.

slots.name: Activation E(x)
slots.definition: How the record builds up against the clock.

chips.formula: n_floor = ln R / -ln(1-s); Dennard: 64.6 % per node, 29.3 % at fixed voltage

cosmos.formula: candidate: R(a)/2 (1 at equilibrium) or E(a) (1 today)

cells.formula: IAM-A = H(eps)/(P H(eps0)); Met-A = reading / healthy of the same kind

slots.name: Saturation event (the wall)
slots.definition: Where the regime changes when the surface fills.

cosmos.formula: Chandrasekhar 1.44 M_sun, TOV about 2.3 M_sun; M_eq = c^3/4GH = 2.3e22 M_sun

qubits.formula: coherence optimum on one material (form only)

cells.formula: to be measured; a Warburg line is a conjecture (PROC-WARBURG-01 class era: P1, P3 not met)

slots.name: Point of no return
slots.definition: Past it, the record cannot be restored.

qubits.formula: adding qubits makes errors grow instead of shrink

cells.formula: DEV-BREACH-01: not visible at the precancer stage; candidate: writing outruns the eraser on the islands
